intro.paragraph1: I'm João Tambue, a Frontend Software Engineer from Luanda, Angola. I have experience building web and mobile applications with React, Vue.js, React Native, TypeScript and JavaScript, crafting scalable, performant, user-experience-driven interfaces, and collaborating with cross-functional teams through code reviews and development best practices.
intro.paragraph2: I have experience with API integrations, modern architectures, automated testing, and using Artificial Intelligence to speed up development cycles and boost productivity. Outside of work, I enjoy taking part in technology and innovation challenges.
